messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 paging: High 5xx error rate on inference-api-prod (region: us-west-2). Current error rate 7.8% over 1m. Pager: @maya on-call. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/trace/abc123

maya: Acked. I'm on it, pulling graphs now. Can someone confirm if any deploys landed in the last 15m?

sam: No deploys. I'm seeing spike coincident with increased batch size for a few customers, maybe batching backpressure. Linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/inf-prod/errors?var-region=us-west-2

lee: Noted. Customer impact: support reported 2 customers seeing timeouts for streaming calls. Dina from CS is aware and notified.

dina: Yep, ticket 9876 opened. Asking customers for request ids. Marked as data-sensitive, not public.

maya: Initial mitigation: temporarily scale up inference pool by +2 nodes and reduce default max_batch_size from 32 -> 16 for prod routing rule. Executing now.

opsbot: autoscaler: added 2 instances to pool infer-prod-pool-02 (requested by maya).

alex: Reducing batch size should reduce queuing, but may raise per-token cost. Fine for now. Also suggest enabling fallback to cpu-instances for small requests to avoid head-of-line.

sam: Pushed routing override to reduce batch size. Confirmed drop in queue length. Error rate down to 4.1% over 1m.

maya: Good. Next: alert tuning — current alert triggers on 5xx_rate > 5% for 1m. That's noisy during short transient bursts. Propose change: alert to 3% over 5m for pg-prod-critical, and add sustained-alert for >5% over 15m that pages sevs. Thoughts?

lee: Agree on smoothing window. Also add per-route error rate panels to the alert page so we can drill into models/customer keys. Right now alert gives global number and it's too coarse.

sam: I'll open an alert PR: change threshold to 3% 5m for pager, keep 5% 1m as annotation only. Also add suppression when total requests < 100/s to avoid noise during low traffic windows.

maya: For post-incident retro and to reduce future TTR, we need a new Grafana dashboard focused on incident retros: golden signals + drilldowns. Proposed panels:
- Request rate (rps) per model (timeseries + heatmap)
- P95/P99 latency by model and route
- 5xx rate +/- per-customer key (table + timeseries)
- Queue length and mean batch size (histogram)
- KV cache hit rate and prefix cache effectiveness
- Synthetic heartbeat pct failures (4xx/5xx)
- Error budget burn rate and alert triggers list
- Recent deploys & config changes (annotations)

maya: Example PromQL snippets I'll include in PR:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route)
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-api"}[5m])) by (le,route)
```

alex: Nice. Also add a drilldown link that filters by route and customer_key and opens logs with the trace ids. That'll save time during live mitigation.

sam: I'll take dashboard ownership for the build and create a new folder: dashboards/incidents/retrospectives/3487654321. Will add panels and a README describing alert mappings and suggested runbook steps.

lee: Who will own the alert PR and the follow-up threshold change?

sam: I'll open both PRs — one for alert rule change and one for dashboard. Maya, can you review alert PR after I draft?

maya: Yep, will review. Also scheduling a short blameless retro tomorrow 10am to decide longer-term fixes (e.g., batching algorithm adjustments, dynamic batch sizing, and route-level rate limits).

dina: From CS: we'll add a customer-facing note template in case incidents take >30m. I'll draft and put in #support-templates.

opsbot: deploy-bot: routing-override applied (batch_size=16) by sam.

maya: Final update: error rate stabilized at 1.2% over 5m after mitigations. Keeping pager open until dashboard + alert PRs merged. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: PRs: https://git.redwood.example/p/alerts/pull/112 (alert rule) and https://git.redwood.example/p/dashboards/pull/58 (dashboard skeleton). Will update links in this thread when merged.

incident-bot: Incident SEV2 -> mitigated. Please file post-incident summary and link to dashboard PRs in the retro ticket.
